curated.tagline: Godot 4.7 city-block tycoon — instrumented like a service: perf baselines, regression gates, capture reels
curated.description: 2D top-down city-block tycoon built in Godot 4.7 (GDScript): run shops, buy property, day/night cycle, weather states, NPCs, save/load. Engineered with a dev-end spine — EventBus autoloads, JSON-driven modular buildings, an EconomyMath library, integer-cent money, and a headless perf harness that writes per-resolution baselines and fails regressions past explicit thresholds.
highlights: Headless perf harness — per-resolution FPS/frame/memory/load baselines
Regression gate with explicit pass thresholds on every change
Day/night cycle, four weather states, occlusion pass
curated.architecture: Godot scenes → EventBus autoloads → JSON building data → EconomyMath lib → headless perf harness → regression diff
